newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Analysts raise forecasts for H&M.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Analysts raise forecasts for H&M.

text.p: Analysts have raised their forecasts for Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz (H&M) for the current year since the company published its earnings for the 12 months to November 30, 1996.

A Reuter poll of 11 analysts showed expectations for 1996/97 had risen with the market forecasting a profit after financial items of 2.37 billion crowns for 1996/1997 compared to 2.28 billion crowns before the 1995/96 report.
H&M posted a 1995/1996 profit of 1.91 billion crowns, which was slightly higher than market expectations of 1.85 billion crowns.
The new estimates for 1996/97 ranged between 2.26 billion crowns and 2.51 billion crowns, compared with a previous range of 2.10 billion crowns and 2.46 billion crowns.
Analysts polled were from Carnegie, Enskilda, Fiba, Goldman Sachs, James Capel, Handelsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Grenfell, Nordiska, Penser, SBC Warburg and Swedbank.
